items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads_reservoir A1 into every sample well, followed by 10 aspirate/dispense 40 uL mix cycles; protocol.comment records the 5 min incubation before the magnet comment.
Magnet engage/wait comment is recorded; log shows 90 uL moved from each of 96 wells to waste, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added and 200 uL removed to waste for every well.
Comments record 5 min air dry and magnet disengage; log shows 50 uL water added per well with 10 x 40 uL mixes; the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage comment follow.
Log lines 6530-6911 show 45 uL aspirated from each sample_plate well and dispensed into the matching elution_plate well (A1->A1 ... H12->H12).
Each move() call picks up a new tip and drops it, so every supernatant, ethanol, water and elution transfer in the log uses its own tip with no reuse between samples.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all steps per well with correct volumes, 10x mixes, and records the incubation, magnet, drying and disengage steps as comments. A fresh tip is used for every sample at every step, and the 45 uL eluate maps A1-H12 to the matching elution plate wells.
